result.question: How much cash and cash equivalents did Apple report at the end of fiscal 2025?
result.answer: Apple reported cash and cash equivalents of $35,934 million (approximately $35.9 billion) at the end of fiscal 2025, which ended on September 27, 2025 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue:2025-09-27]. This figure is also confirmed on the condensed consolidated balance sheet included in Apple's 8-K press release, which lists cash and cash equivalents of $35,934 million as of September 27, 2025 [0000320193-25-000077:ex-99-press-release-p003]. The cash flow statement in the 10-K shows ending cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash and cash equivalents of $35,934 million for the same date [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p004].
